maria_devex: Heads-up — hitting a weird bug in the Python SDK when using async tool/function calling with structured output + automatic retries. Sample app loses typed fields (e.g., invoice_number) when an auth refresh triggers a retry. @sam_backend can you take a look? :eyes:

sam_backend: Can you paste a minimal repro and any server logs you have?

maria_devex: Minimal repro below (very small):
```python
import os
import asyncio
from redwood import RedwoodClient

client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv(\"RW_KEY\"))

async def run():
    # tool registered server-side returns structured JSON per function schema
    resp = await client.call_tool(\"invoice_parser\", text, retry=2)
    # expected: resp.structured -> {'invoice_number': 'INV-123', 'total': 123.45}
    print(repr(resp.structured))

asyncio.run(run())
```

Observed locally: printed `{'text': 'Invoice parsed: INV-123'}` — missing typed fields.
Logs show: `[auth] refreshing token` then `retrying request (1)` around the same time the function call completed on server.

sam_backend: Thanks. Which SDK version?

maria_devex: 0.12.3. Repro on macOS and in CI container. Pinning to 0.12.1 seems to avoid the issue.

dinesh: I can repro with 0.12.3. Looks like a regression after the auth middleware change (we moved retries earlier in the request pipeline). I also see the `x-rw-function-schema` header missing on retried requests in the capture.

ryan: If retries are outside the function-parser path we might be dropping per-request metadata that the server uses to cast structured output. Can you capture raw request headers around retry?

maria_devex: captured headers. On first try: `x-rw-function-schema: {..}` present. On retry: header missing. Server returns raw text blob and SDK falls back to `text` field.

sam_backend: I'll open an issue and a quick PR. Creating issue now.

ci-cd-bot: New issue created: RW-issue-8004 - \"py-sdk: structured output lost on retry after auth refresh\"

sam_backend: PR #4521 opened with a small patch to preserve function schema header across retries (keeps metadata in RetryableRequest wrapper). Includes unit test that simulates auth refresh. Needs integration sample verification.

maria_devex: pulled #4521 and re-ran sample app — patch fixes the repro for me. Verified structured fields now present. :tada:

ryan: Nice. Can we add a regression/integration test in CI that simulates token refresh and checks structured output parsing? Also backport to 0.12.4 release.

sam_backend: Yep — adding CI test and changelog note. Will target a patch release.

maria_devex: One small onboarding note: the sample-app tutorial currently uses 0.12.x without a pinned minor; I'll add a short warning until 0.12.4 is out so new users don't hit this.

eng-oncall-bot: Triage scheduled for 2026-03-21 10:30 PT. Linked in #incidents.

sam_backend: Closing loop: PR merged, backport branch created, changelog updated. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. If anyone sees other weirdness with async toolcall parity vs TS SDK please ping me.

maria_devex: Thanks! Leaving a quick repro gist in the docs repo and will add a one-liner to the troubleshooting guide. :thumbsup:
